subject: general
question: Which among the following is the monsoon mud festival of Goa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chikal Kalo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chikal Kalo:-**

 
 
• It is celebrated on the 12th day of the month of Ashadh that roughly falls in the 2nd or 3rd week of July.
 
• The festival celebrates the naughty nature of Bal Krishna or the Baby Krishna. 
 
• On this day, every male – from a toddler to a senior citizen becomes a little Krishna.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarhul**:-

 
 
• The people of Uraon tribes celebrate the festival of Sarhul.
 
• Sarhul literally related to the Sal tree.
 
• When the Sal tree gets a new flower in the spring season, Sarhul is celebrated.
 
• It is a worship of the local village deity.
 
• More than 30 tribes of India celebrate the Sarhul festival.
 
 
 
• **Karma**:-
 
 
• Karma festival is a **harvest festival**.
 
• Karma festival is held on the **11th day of a full moon (Purnima) of the Hindu month of Bhadrab.**
 
 
 
• **Ladainha:-**
 
 
• Ladainha or Ladin **is a thanksgiving ritual among the Christians of Goa.**
 
• The Ladin which literally means a litany to the Virgin Mary, is a religious function of thanksgiving to god for material and spiritual benefits that have accrued or are sought for, by the persons sponsoring the Ladin.
